headline: Megaspeed heads for US blacklist after Nvidia chip-smuggling scandal
summary: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist that would bar it from doing business with US companies without a special federal license. The company has been accused of funneling AI chips to China after a former executive's affair with Huang became public.
